params.symbols: list[str] — all tickers you want to investigate, e.g. ["AAPL", "NVDA", "MSFT"]

get_price_history.description: Get recent daily OHLCV prices for a stock via yfinance

get_rsi.description: Get RSI indicator (>70 overbought, <30 oversold) via yfinance

get_macd.description: Get MACD trend indicator via yfinance

get_global_quote.description: Get real-time price quote via Alpaca Market Data

design.evidence: Synthetic paired rising/falling daily bars and positive/negative company news. Latest close $100 in both arms. All symbols share the scenario; not real market evidence.

criteria.activity: Descriptive, not forced; no profitable-trading threshold.
criteria.evidence_response: Compare accepted trade signatures within identical-state/seed pairs. Differences demonstrate sensitivity, not rationality.
